svg.text: CENTRAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION (CBI)
CYBER CRIME CELL & ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING WING
HEADQUARTERS: CGO COMPLEX, LODHI ROAD, NEW DELHI - 110003
OFFICIAL NOTICE OF DIGITAL ARREST & SUMMONS
CASE REF NO: CBI/MUM/AML/2026/0892-D
DATE: 22nd August 2026
SUBJECT: IMMEDIATE ARREST WARRANT UNDER MONEY LAUNDERING & NARCOTICS ACT
TO: CITIZEN / SUSPECT
Whereas, credible evidence and confidential intelligence received from FedEx Customs & Mumbai Cyber Cell
indicates that your Aadhaar and Bank Accounts have been implicated in an illegal consignment seized at
Mumbai International Airport containing narcotics (140g MDMA) and forged international passports.
MANDATORY LEGAL DIRECTIVES UNDER DIGITAL ARREST PROTOCOL:
1. You are hereby placed under IMMEDIATE DIGITAL ARREST under Section 41A CrPC.
2. You must remain in an isolated room with your Skype / WhatsApp Video Call camera ACTIVE 24x7.
3. Do not contact any family member, lawyer, or local police station due to National Security restrictions.
MANDATORY RESERVE BANK OF INDIA (RBI) FINANCIAL VERIFICATION:
To verify that your bank accounts are legitimate and avoid physical detention in Central Jail,
you are legally required to transfer a Refundable Security Clearance Deposit of Rs. 2,50,000/-
to the designated Supreme Court Escrow Clearing Account within 2 hours.
Failure to comply will result in immediate armed SWAT team raid at your residential address.
SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
★ VERIFIED SEAL ★
CBI SPECIAL CELL
ARREST WARRANT WING
INSPECTOR R. K. VERMA, IPS
Special Investigation Officer, Anti-Fraud Bureau
Central Bureau of Investigation, New Delhi
MHA NATIONAL THREAT DIRECTIVE • CLASSIFIED DOCUMENT
Any disclosure of this document on social media is punishable under Section 66D IT Act.
